remarks:
**A GREAT OPPORTUNITY TO START OR EXPAND YOUR REAL ESTATE PORTFOLIO!** Welcome to 34 Ullman Street, a spacious two-unit property in Buffalo's Riverside neighborhood! Whether you're looking to purchase your first investment property, live in one apartment while renting the other, or add another income-producing property to your portfolio, this Buffalo double offers plenty of possibilities!

Featuring two generously sized 3-bedroom, 1-bath apartments, this approximately 2,018-square-foot property offers a total of six bedrooms and two full bathrooms. Both apartments provide comfortable living spaces, functional layouts, and access to porches, offering additional outdoor space to enjoy. A driveway, backyard, and full basement add convenience and functionality for residents.

For those just entering the real estate investment market, this property offers an opportunity to begin building a rental portfolio with two units under one roof. Experienced investors will appreciate the desirable three-bedroom configurations, established two-family layout, and potential to enhance long-term value through improvements and updates.

Conveniently located in Buffalo's Riverside neighborhood, with access to shopping, restaurants, parks, and major roadways. Whether you're looking to offset your housing expenses, generate rental income, or grow your investment portfolio, **34 Ullman Street is an opportunity worth exploring!**
